title: BiomeLock
description: BiomeLock lets server admins lock specific biomes, preventing players from entering or doing actions inside.
body:
BiomeLock is a plugin that lets admins lock biomes. Players cannot enter locked biomes or perform actions inside them, including building, breaking blocks, interacting, using items, and more.

When a player enters a locked biome, BiomeLock teleports them outside the biome. Locked biomes are stored in the config, and admins can manage them in-game with `/biomelock`.

## Features

- Lock and unlock any biome
- Prevent players from entering locked biomes
- Block gameplay actions inside locked biomes

## Commands

- `/biomelock lock <biome>`
- `/biomelock unlock <biome>`
- `/biomelock list`
- `/biomelock reload`
- `/biomelock tpout <player>`
- `/biomelock status <biome>`

## Permissions

- `biomelock.admin` - Access to all commands
- `biomelock.bypass` - Bypass all biome locks
